operation_details.item: The user completed the Acme Corp renewal negotiation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just a quick update – I finally wrapped up the Acme Corp renewal negotiation this morning. Feels like a weight off my shoulders.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's great to hear! You've been working on that one for a while. How did the final conversation go?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Really well, actually. The renewal contract is already sent over for signature, so we're just waiting on their legal team now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Did you bring up the expansion add-on we discussed last week, or is that still a separate conversation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I did bring it up, and they seemed interested. I've proposed the expansion add-on as part of the overall package, so we'll see how it shakes out.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a solid move. Have you thought about the transition to customer success once the contract is signed?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I already have the handoff to customer success scheduled for early next week, so that's covered.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Awesome, sounds like you've got everything lined up. Let me know if you need any help with the internal notes or follow-up tasks.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I completed the Acme renewal negotiation; keep the contract status, expansion, and handoff.
